english.title: Defendant fail to comply with requirement to provide name / date of birth / nationality
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a defendant in proceedings in a criminal court, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement imposed by the court by virtue of section 86A(1) of the Courts Act 2003 to provide your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[date of birth]_
(C)_[nationality]_
(D)_[combination of the above]_

by providing

(E)_[false]_
(F)_[incomplete]_
(G)_[false and incomplete]_
(H)_[no]

information
english.legislation: Contrary to section 86A (3) and (5) of the Courts Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The criminal court requiring the information may deal with any suspected offence under section 86A(3), see section 86A(6) of the Courts Act 2003.
